thread:
devon: quick ping — opened PR to add Sunbridge enterprise firewall + PSK rotation tweaks for private deploy. customer blocked on config, requesting quick eyes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sunbridge-private-config/pull/78  CC @maria @sanjay

sanjay: on it, will try to review in ~30m :eyes:

maria: thanks for flagging. is this backwards compatible? any planned downtime?

devon: no downtime expected — changes are additive. main bits: updated configmap for route/peering entries and PSK rotation cron. snippet from the PR: ```yaml
route_table:
  - name: peering-10
    action: allow
psk_rotation:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *" # 02:00 UTC
```

lin: heads up CI complaining about a lint error in `deploy/scripts/rotate_psk.sh` (missing newline at EOF)

devon: fixed and pushed a small commit (force-pushed to keep history clean). new commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sunbridge-private-config/pull/78/commits/5dfa3c

ci-bot: CI status — unit-tests: passed, infra-lint: failed. logs: https://ci.redwood/teams/infra/12345

maria: i can approve once infra-lint is green. @sanjay can you double-check the route entry? want to avoid opening broader peering accidentally.

sanjay: looked through the route change — ok for peering-10. left one comment about referencing the security group by id vs name (small safety nit).

devon: good catch, switched to SG id and updated description. also ran `make format` and `make test` locally. pushed another commit.

ci-bot: CI status — all checks passed :white_check_mark:

maria: :thumbsup: approving now. will merge during the customer maintenance window unless someone objects.

ops-bot: NOTE: Sunbridge customer maintenance window scheduled 2026-04-15T02:00Z — operations will be on-call.

maria: customer said they can take it now. merging to unblock them; i've got rollback playbook ready if anything flares.

devon: :rocket: merged. thanks all. i'll follow up with the customer and monitor metrics for 30m.

ci-bot: deploy triggered to staging and private infra; watch logs at https://ci.redwood/teams/deploy/87543

lin: saw the new config rollout start, no immediate errors in logs.

maria: closing the loop with Sunbridge now — will update ticket once they confirm end-to-end.

devon: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround!
